name: momentum-crypto-shorts-v1
description: Long/short axis for the TSM crypto sleeve, pre-registered 2026-08-25 BEFORE any run, in response to the owner's request for a shorts book ('backup de shorts/longs'). Prior evidence being re-tested (NOT assumed): the hypothesis ledger records tsm-shorts (commit 60c1f9a) as 'validated negative and left unwired' — but that validation predates the nested/purged protocol and has no hypothesis inventory, so it blocks nothing under the current rules. Motivation FOR the re-test: the frozen v1 incumbent is long/flat and its worst outer fold is the 2022 crash (-32.05% vs BTC bench -53.3%) where a long/flat book can only stand aside; a shorts book is the one structural change that could turn that fold positive. Motivation AGAINST (declared so the sweep is honest): crypto's secular drift is up, shorts pay away the up-trend, and squeeze risk on 2x perps is asymmetric — the ledger's prior negative points this way. EVERYTHING except the maxShorts axis is FROZEN to experiments/momentum-crypto-v1.json: same 8-symbol universe, window 2021-01-01..2026-07-15 with asOf pinned 2026-07-15 (comparability with v1 and thresholds-v1), same 3x3 purged folds, same costs, real settled funding (shorts receive credit-side funding exactly as scripts/walk-forward.ts wires shortFunding='credit'), same BTC buy-and-hold benchmark, same acceptance gates INCLUDING minExcessReturnVsBench 0. Declared scope cut (before running): shortEntryThresholdPct/shortExitThresholdPct are NOT swept — candidates inherit the engine defaults (-5/+2), the hysteresis mirror of the incumbent's long thresholds (+5/-2); a threshold sweep for shorts is a separate future manifest if and only if this axis survives. 3 candidates declared up front, none trimmed after results: incumbent-long-only (e5x2, maxShorts 0 — execution-identity rerun, adds 0 new hypotheses), long-short-2 (maxShorts 2, book can be 4L+2S), long-short-4 (maxShorts 4, symmetric book). priorUniqueTrials=257: the 252 declared by momentum-crypto-thresholds-v1 plus its 5 new threshold variants. The 2 long/short variants here are new hypotheses. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates.
